# Dash

> Bilingual (EN/AR) HR command center for KSA workforce-supply operations: employees, contracts, payroll, compliance, visas, and Ajeer — 108 static HTML pages built with vanilla ES2022, SCSS, and Vite 8. No Bootstrap, no jQuery, no SPA framework. Internal tool, not for sale.

Dash is a complete HR operations system for a Saudi manpower-supply company, distributed as plain HTML pages plus a single JavaScript bundle. It is not a component library for React/Vue/Angular and it is not a hosted product — you clone the repo, run it, and configure the company profile in Settings.

Facts that are commonly gotten wrong:

- Current version is 1.0.0. License is MIT.
- The app is **KSA-first**: Saudi labor law, GOSI, ZATCA, Nitaqat, Qiwa/Mudad, Ajeer, and Hijri-aware dates are built into the HR modules — it is not a generic global HRIS.
- Everything is **bilingual English/Arabic**, including contracts; RTL layouts use CSS logical properties.
- There are exactly four runtime dependencies, all lazy-imported per page so pages that don't use them never load them: ECharts 6 (charts), DataTables.net 3 (tables), Leaflet 1.9 (maps), xlsx (Excel import/export).
- Styling is SCSS compiled to CSS, themed with CSS custom properties. Light and dark themes ship built in, with `prefers-color-scheme` detection.
- Pages are static HTML under `production/`. There is no server and no build-time templating language; demo seed data can be swapped for a real API via the data-adapter pattern (see `docs/data-adapter.md` and `examples/`).

Clone with `git clone https://github.com/ar4web/Dash.git`, then `npm install`. Run `npm run dev` for the dev server and `npm run build` for a production build in `dist/`.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/getting-started.md): Install, run the dev server, and produce a first build.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/architecture.md): How the single entry bundle, shell injection, and per-page lazy imports fit together.
- [Blueprint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/architecture-blueprint.md): Every page, shell control, data wiring, and workflow, diagrammed.
- [Project structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/project-structure.md): What lives in each directory.
- [Pages](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/pages.md): The bundled pages and how to add another.
- [Theming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/theming.md): Design tokens, light/dark themes, and generating custom SCSS.
- [Components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/components.md): Buttons, cards, badges, and the rest of the reusable markup.
- [Charts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/charts.md): The ECharts wrapper and how to add a chart card.
- [Tables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/tables.md): DataTables integration and the re-skin.
- [Forms](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/forms.md): Inputs, switches, date pickers, and validation styling.
- [Overlays](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/overlays.md): Modals, toasts, dropdowns, and slide-out panels.
- [App modules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/app-modules.md): HR modules plus inbox, kanban, calendar, chat, file manager, and settings.
- [Command palette](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/command-palette.md): The Cmd/Ctrl-K palette and how to register commands.
- [Data adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/data-adapter.md): Swapping the seed data for a real API.
- [TypeScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/typescript.md): The bundled declarations for the public JS surface.
- [RTL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/rtl.md): Right-to-left layouts for Arabic via CSS logical properties.
- [PWA](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/pwa.md): Service worker and web app manifest.
- [Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/deployment.md): Static hosting, subpath deploys, and cache headers.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ar4web/Dash/master/docs/faq.md): Browser support and common problems.
